subject: Renewal + expansion: align roadmap demo windows across stakeholders
messages:
From: Sanjay Gupta <sanjay.gupta@novawell.com>
To: logan_wright <logan.wright@redwood.inference>
Cc: Clara Ortiz <c.ortiz@novawell.com>
Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal QBR + roadmap demo — availability and scope

Hi Logan,

Hope you had a good week — NovaWell is starting renewal planning and we'd like to combine the QBR with a short roadmap/demo focused on the expansion use cases we discussed (dedicated capacity, embedding rollout, and latency SLAs).

High level asks:
- 30–45 minute roadmap demo for product + execs
- Quick walkthrough (~15 min) of Dedicated capacity and failover/fallback behavior
- One-line compliance note re: SOC2/data residency (we may need a short pre-call with security)

Preferred week: Apr 12–16 (we can be flexible but our VP of Prod, Clara, has limited windows). Can you propose 2x options (one morning PT, one late afternoon PT) and include any folks from your solutions/infra team who'll demo Dedicated?

Thanks — looking forward to aligning on scope so we can finalize the renewal commitment.

—Sanjay
Sanjay Gupta
Head of Platform Integrations, NovaWell
Sanjay.Gupta@novawell.com

Subject: Re: Renewal QBR + roadmap demo — availability and scope

Thanks Sanjay — this sounds good. Proposed windows (all PT):

Option A: Tue Apr 13, 10:00–10:45am PT / 1:00–1:45pm ET
Option B: Thu Apr 15, 4:00–4:45pm PT / 7:00–7:45pm ET (only if execs prefer an after-lunch US slot)

Attendees (internal): me, Marissa (CS lead), Stephanie (Solutions Eng), + infra engineer (TBD). We’ll prepare a 25-minute demo + 15-minute Q&A.

Agenda draft:
- 5m: introductions & renewal context
- 20m: roadmap demo (dedicated capacity, batch/latency SLOs, caching) — Marissa + Stephanie
- 10m: Dedicated capacity failover/fallback behavior + security summary — infra
- 10m: next steps & procurement timeline

I attached a short deck (NovaWell_Roadmap_2027_v2.pdf) with the demo outline and suggested KPIs. If Clara or you have specific metrics to highlight (e.g., p95 latency targets, per-request cost targets, retention/purge cadence), flag them and we’ll surface during the demo.

If either option works, we’ll send a calendar invite and include a 15-minute pre-demo sync with our security lead to address compliance questions. Also adding a Doodle-style availability link for other stakeholders: https://doodle.com/scheduling/nw-demo-4521

—Logan

Hi Logan / Sanjay,

Thanks for the options. Option A (Tue Apr 13 at 10am PT) works best for our execs — Clara will be traveling on the 15th. Can you please:
- Confirm a recording will be available for stakeholders who can’t make it
- Include a short (10–15m) pre-demo with your security lead earlier that day or the day before — we need to review SOC 2 evidence and a note on EU data residency if possible
- Add any enablement materials for our ML team (in particular, embedding dimension and indexing approach)

We’re excited to see the Dedicated failover behavior in action — that will be a key ask from our SREs before we finalize the commit.

—Clara

Quick ops notes / attachments:
- Attached: run_of_show_novawell_0427.pdf (5 slides) — outlines who demos which section and the demo checklist.
- Recording: yes, we’ll record and share the recording + assets within 24 hours.
- CS asks: Clara, please send the two KPIs you want highlighted (availability SLA target, and one business metric) — we’ll surface them in the slides.

For RD/infra: Stephanie — can you bring a light failover demo (simulated node drop & fallback to backup pool) and note the expected p95 impact? Rishi — please bring the SOC2 summary and a note about EU data residency options (we can keep it high-level in the demo and follow up with artifacts).

On Tue I’ll also update the HubSpot opportunity (HS-54219) with the new demo date and next steps. Logan — please add the final attendee list and any additional enablement links.

Thanks all — see you Tuesday.

—Marissa
